confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderate confidence; July hostel and hotel rates are lower because peak-season and festival-period rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.9x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. USD values assume about 1.34 USD per GBP from remembered levels; no live GBP rate was checked. The RBA observation could not be verified, so fx is null: the searches returned links only, and a search summary's March 2026 figure is stale and unverified, so it was not used. Search output also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No named comparable city was used. The basis is UK city-break price levels anchored on remembered Edinburgh pub, restaurant and accommodation prices, brought forward to July 2026. Peak-summer accommodation pricing is included.
